audience: Romanian businesses and their accountants who invoice customers with Oblio

useCases.title: Find invoices that are not collected yet
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by series, dates, client and draft, canceled or collected state, and reads one document with its collections.

useCases.title: Show the invoices issued to one client
useCases.text: The AI finds a client by name or CIF and lists the invoices for that client since a date. You can add the e-Factura (SPV) status of each invoice.

useCases.title: Check document series, VAT rates and products
useCases.text: The AI lists the document series with the next number, the VAT rates, and the products and services with unit, price and VAT.

useCases.title: Create a proforma for a client
useCases.text: The AI checks the series and VAT rates, then creates a proforma, which is not a fiscal invoice. It takes the next number of the series at once.

useCases.title: Issue an invoice and record its payment
useCases.text: The AI issues a real invoice, which is a fiscal document that cannot be edited, and records that an invoice was paid. You approve each step.

useCases.title: Send an e-invoice, or cancel or restore a document
useCases.text: The AI sends an issued invoice to ANAF e-Factura (SPV), or cancels an invoice, proforma or notice, or restores a cancelled one.
